The determination of the success is not subject to a fixed logic and can be performed by an installation-specific function module
for event 0393. SAP provides the sample module FKK_SAMPLE_0393 where, for example, each payment received within 7 days of
dunning is seen as a100% success. Each further day of delay reduces the success percentage rate by 2.5%.

«° Example
If EUR 100 is dunned, and a payment of EUR 70 is received after 7 days, and the remaining amount of EUR 30 is paid after 15

days, this results in a success percentage rate of 100% for EUR 70, and 80% for EUR 30. The weighted average is then 94%.
The valuation run enters this value in the dunning history.

Activities
1.In the SAP menu, choose |}Periodic Processing » For Contract Accounts » Dunning > Success Valuation of Dunning
(transaction FPVV).

2. Enter a date and an ID that you can use to identify the run later.

3. On the Selections tab page, you can restrict the dunnings to be selected by business partner and company code or the run
parameters of one or more dunning runs.

A. Schedule the program run. For more information, see Functions for Scheduling Program Runs.

Creditworthiness

Use

The creditworthiness of a business partner provides information on the business partner’s payment history and influences the
selection of activities for dunning and/or returns and also the calculation of charges. Various different business transactions, such

as returns, dunning notices, installment plans, and write-offs update the creditworthiness in the system automatically. You can also
transfer a creditworthiness record from external systems or manually.

By default, the FI-CA creditworthiness of a business partner is calculated as a weighted total of the creditworthiness figures from
the past 48 months (maximum). You define the monthly weightings in Customizing. A creditworthiness of zero means that the
business partner has an excellent payment history. The maximum value is 9999. At event 0400, you can override the default

calculation of the FI-CA creditworthiness.
The creditworthiness value of a business partner results from the following parameters:

e The calculation type of the total creditworthiness

You define how the system determines the total creditworthiness in Customizing for Contract Accounts Receivable and
Payable under |Integration » Financial Supply Chain Management Credit Management's Define Specifications for

Credit Management ; in the Calculation Type field. For more information about the calculation options, see the
documentation for the field.

If you change the calculation type from SPACE to another value or change the value to SPACE, you must execute the

mass activity Replicate Creditworthiness (transaction FPCM2) to replicate the external creditworthiness again.
